headline: HUMAIN raised its 2027 build target to 1.7 GW and confirmed a separate compute-infrastructure fund alongside a USD 2.5bn data-centre fund managed by BSF Capital, with no server, storage or cooling vendor named. Micron reported FQ4 revenue of $54.2bn against a $50.0bn guide, guided FQ1 at $61.5bn and said 2027-28 memory supply will be much tighter, with more than 75% of 2027 output already committed. HPE booked the first AMD Helios rack order ($1.2bn from Vultr), which matters because AMD is HUMAIN's named partner. Regionally, Anmat won a SAR 129.9M HADAF award and Rönesans-Digital Realty started building in Ankara with a 200 MW target.
lenovo_read: HUMAIN's compute fund makes financing and delivery certainty the deciding factors for its racks, so Lenovo needs a TruScale or partner-financed AMD/NVIDIA offer before HPE turns its Helios reference into a Saudi default. On IDG, Micron's guidance means 2027 device pricing rises, not eases: lock memory allocation now.

pillars.dc: 2 META items: HUMAIN 1.7 GW 2027 target and financing structure; Rönesans-Digital Realty Türkiye construction start with a 200 MW / up to USD 3bn target. Global: Tencent leasing about 100,000 NVIDIA chips in Oracle Southeast Asia data centres; HPE AMD Helios order. Submer-ACES KSA MoU rejected (first published 30 Sep 10:53 KSA, before the window).
pillars.memory: 6 scored items led by Micron FQ4 ($54.2bn revenue, FQ1 guide $61.5bn, 2027-28 supply much tighter). September DRAMeXchange contract: PC DRAM DDR4 8Gb $26.00 (+4.0% MoM, record), NAND 128Gb MLC $30.61 (+0.44%). Spot 1 Oct: DDR5 16Gb $57.933, DDR4 16Gb $83.662. Korea September chip exports a record $60.3bn; Huawei says memory added about $200 per Mate 90; Samsung raised Galaxy S26 prices in Korea.
pillars.deals: 6 scored items: HUMAIN-EY AI-native BPO, Anmat-HADAF SAR 129.9M, IFS-Echelon industrial AI, PwC-Google Cloud Riyadh, Microsoft-CSC-Core42 MDASH, Rönesans-Digital Realty. No hardware supplier named in any in-window META deal; no Tadawul filing from MIS, solutions, stc or Elm.
pillars.global: Scored Microsoft (Core42), Google Cloud (PwC), AWS (UAE AI Office), EY (HUMAIN) and Lenovo AI Express. Chinese rule: Tencent, Huawei (Ascend and Mate 90), Xiaomi, vivo, Honor, Haier and ByteDance. Nothing verifiable in window from Alibaba, Hikvision, Hisense, ZTE or OPPO.

stories.title: Humain scales up 2027 data center target as it aims for a self-funding buildout
stories.summary: HUMAIN CEO Tareq Amin set a 1.7 GW target for 2027, with about 3 GW by 2030 and 6 GW by 2034. A USD 2.5bn domestic data-centre fund managed by BSF Capital is in regulatory approval, and a separate unsized compute-infrastructure fund is planned. xAI and AWS are named off-takers; at USD 10-12M per MW the 2027 build is about USD 20bn (EnterpriseAM estimate).
bullets: Humain is targeting 1.7 GW of capacity by 2027, up from the 1 GW stated before, with 250 MW online by the end of this year, about 3 GW by 2030 and 6 GW by 2034
A domestic data center fund is seeking an initial USD 2.5 bn, with BSF Capital managing the debt-and-equity structure, and a separate compute-infrastructure fund is planned
Anchor clients include xAI, Amazon Web Services and several open-weight model companies, with building costs put at USD 10-12 million per MW
stories.lenovo: ISG/SSG: the clearest sign yet that HUMAIN will finance compute through its own vehicle. Hardware undisclosed, the largest open ISG opportunity in META. A compute fund rewards vendors that bring financing and delivery certainty (TruScale, partner-financed racks, Neptune cooling). Enlarges OPP-001, 027, 036 and 042.
stories.arabic: هيوماين ترفع مستهدف سعة مراكز البيانات لعام 2027 إلى 1.7 غيغاواط، مع صندوق محلي بقيمة 2.5 مليار دولار تديره الفرنسي كابيتال وصندوق منفصل للبنية التحتية للحوسبة.

stories.title: HUMAIN Engages EY MENA to Develop Saudi Arabia's First AI-Native Business Process Outsourcing Service
stories.summary: HUMAIN and EY MENA will build Saudi Arabia's first AI-native business-process-outsourcing service on HUMAIN ONE. HUMAIN provides the AI infrastructure and EY the functional expertise and go-to-market. No value or launch date was given.
bullets: HUMAIN, a PIF company, has engaged EY MENA to develop Saudi Arabia's first AI-native business process outsourcing service, combining intelligent agents, automation, advanced analytics and human expertise
The service is built on HUMAIN ONE, HUMAIN's integrated agentic AI platform for enterprise workflows and automation
EY brings finance, audit, tax and advisory capabilities, with statements from HUMAIN CEO Tareq Amin, EY Global Managing Partner Raj Sharma and EY MENA Chairman Abdulaziz Al-Sowailim
stories.lenovo: IDG/SSG: an AI-native BPO still needs supervised staff, delivery centres and secure endpoints, a device-as-a-service and managed-workplace opportunity with EY as likely integrator. Shows HUMAIN moving up the stack into services.
stories.arabic: هيوماين تتعاون مع إي واي الشرق الأوسط وشمال أفريقيا لتطوير أول خدمة إسناد عمليات أعمال قائمة على الذكاء الاصطناعي في المملكة عبر منصة HUMAIN ONE.

stories.title: "أنماط" تتلقى إشعار ترسية مشروع تأهيل مقر "هدف" بـ130مليون ريال
stories.summary: Anmat Technology received an award notice from the Human Resources Development Fund (HADAF) to rehabilitate its Riyadh headquarters, valued at SAR 129.9M including VAT. Signing is expected 30 Nov 2026. It is separate from Anmat's SAR 314.5M SEC device contract.
bullets: تلقت شركة أنماط التقنية للتجارة إشعار ترسية من صندوق تنمية الموارد البشرية (هدف) لتأهيل المقر الرئيسي للصندوق في الرياض
تبلغ قيمة المشروع 129.92 مليون ريال شاملة ضريبة القيمة المضافة 15%
صدر إشعار الترسية في 30 سبتمبر 2026، والموعد المتوقع لتوقيع العقد 30 نوفمبر 2026، ولا توجد أطراف ذات علاقة
stories.lenovo: IDG/SSG: mainly fit-out, but government HQ rehabilitations usually carry devices, meeting-room AV and network refresh; brand undisclosed. Anmat's second large award this year makes it a priority integrator for Lenovo IDG KSA (OPP-050, OPP-054).
stories.arabic: أنماط للتقنية تتلقى إشعار ترسية من صندوق تنمية الموارد البشرية "هدف" لتأهيل مقره الرئيسي في الرياض بقيمة 129.9 مليون ريال شاملة ضريبة القيمة المضافة.

stories.title: IFS and Echelon announce strategic partnership to drive industrial AI transformation to Saudi Arabia
stories.summary: Riyadh-based Echelon will deploy and localise IFS.ai industrial AI across energy, oil and gas, manufacturing, aerospace and defence, logistics and telecoms. No value disclosed.
bullets: Riyadh-headquartered Echelon will deploy and localize IFS.ai across Saudi industry, focusing on energy, manufacturing, oil and gas, aerospace and defence, logistics and telecommunications
The release says Saudi Arabia's industrial base accounted for 45% of its US$1.1 trillion GDP in 2024
Prince Khalid Bin Bader Al Saud is Echelon's Founder and Managing Director, and Mark Moffat is CEO of IFS
stories.lenovo: ISG/IDG: Echelon (OPP-033) is assembling an industrial-AI software portfolio with no named compute partner. Plant-level AI means ThinkEdge and workstations; Lenovo should be Echelon's default hardware reference.
stories.arabic: آي إف إس وإيشلون تعلنان شراكة استراتيجية لنشر منصة الذكاء الاصطناعي الصناعي في المملكة لقطاعات الطاقة والتصنيع والنفط والغاز والدفاع.

stories.title: PwC Middle East accelerates digital innovation with the launch of a Google Cloud AI Experience Zone in Riyadh
stories.summary: PwC Middle East opened a Google Cloud AI Experience Zone at its Laysen Valley regional HQ in Riyadh, built on Gemini Enterprise, for client workshops and sector demos.
bullets: PwC Middle East opened a Google Cloud AI Experience Zone at its regional headquarters in Laysen Valley, Riyadh, where clients can try AI agents and workflows built by PwC and Google Cloud
The zone is enabled by Gemini Enterprise and the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform and will host client events, workshops and sector-specific demonstrations
Spokespeople are Bassel El Atab, Partner, Data & Cloud at PwC Middle East, and Abdul Rahman Al Thehaiban, Managing Director, Google Cloud Middle East, North Africa and Turkey
stories.lenovo: IDG/SSG: advisory firms are building AI showrooms with hyperscalers in Riyadh; Lenovo AI PCs and on-prem inference are absent from these first-impression venues.
stories.arabic: بي دبليو سي الشرق الأوسط تطلق منطقة تجربة للذكاء الاصطناعي من غوغل كلاود في مقرها الإقليمي بوادي ليسن في الرياض.

stories.title: Microsoft, UAE Cyber Security Council and Core42 unite to scale AI-powered cyber defense across UAE government
stories.summary: Microsoft's MDASH AI cyber-defence capability will be deployed across UAE government entities on Core42's Sovereign Public Cloud, with the Cyber Security Council supporting adoption via its National AI Test and Validation Lab. Phased rollout; no value.
bullets: Microsoft, the UAE Cyber Security Council and Core42, a G42 company, will deploy MDASH, Microsoft's AI-powered cybersecurity capability, across UAE government entities
The Council will support adoption through the National AI Test and Validation Lab, while Core42 handles onboarding through its Sovereign Public Cloud partnership with Microsoft
The rollout is phased, moving from awareness sessions to pilots, workshops and onboarding
stories.lenovo: ISG/SSG: more UAE government workloads on Core42's sovereign cloud means more sovereign capacity; hardware undisclosed. Strengthens OPP-040 and OPP-018.
stories.arabic: مايكروسوفت ومجلس الأمن السيبراني الإماراتي وCore42 تنشر قدرات الدفاع السيبراني بالذكاء الاصطناعي في الجهات الحكومية عبر السحابة العامة السيادية.

stories.title: Rönesans ve Digital Realty’den Türkiye’ye veri merkezi yatırımı
stories.summary: Construction has started on phase 1 of the Rönesans-Digital Realty Ankara Temelli campus (22+ MW IT, about 10,000 m2 colocation, due 2028). The JV targets 200 MW across Ankara and Istanbul with up to USD 3bn of investment potential. The JV itself was announced 14-15 Sep; the target and construction start are new.
bullets: Rönesans Altyapı ile Digital Realty ortaklığının ilk kampüsü için Ankara Temelli’de inşaata başlandı; ilk faz 22 MW’ın üzerinde IT kapasitesi ve yaklaşık 10 bin metrekare kolokasyon alanıyla 2028’de faaliyete geçecek
Ankara ve İstanbul’la toplam 200 MW IT kapasitesi hedefleniyor ve yatırım potansiyeli 3 milyar dolara kadar çıkıyor
Bu kapasite Ulusal Yapay Zeka Eylem Planı’nın 2030 için koyduğu 1 GW hedefinin yüzde 20’sine denk geliyor
stories.lenovo: ISG: carrier-neutral campus, so the opportunity is tenant fit-out (Turkcell, Türk Telekom, banks, public cloud). Hardware undisclosed. Updates OPP-006 with an 18-month runway.
stories.arabic: رونيسانس وديجيتال ريالتي تبدآن بناء المرحلة الأولى من مركز بيانات أنقرة بسعة تتجاوز 22 ميغاواط، ضمن خطة للوصول إلى 200 ميغاواط واستثمارات تصل إلى 3 مليارات دولار في تركيا.

stories.title: UAE AI Office and AWS announce 72% AI adoption rate across UAE businesses
stories.summary: An AWS-commissioned Strand Partners survey finds 72% of UAE businesses use AI, up from 53%; skills and funding are the main barriers. AWS restates up to AED 20.1bn of UAE investment by 2037 and a $1bn sovereign-cloud commitment with e&.
bullets: 72% of UAE businesses have adopted AI, up from 53% a year earlier, and 85% of adopters report a faster pace of digital change
AWS is investing AED 20.1 billion ($5.47 billion) in its Middle East (UAE) Region through 2037, with an estimated GDP contribution of AED 41 billion ($11.16 billion)
The AWS and e& partnership commits $1 billion to sovereign cloud and AI, and the AI Nation – Afaaq Program aims to give 30,000 people free AWS training
stories.lenovo: IDG/SSG: high adoption with a funding barrier points to consumption models (TruScale, DaaS) for the UAE mid-market; AWS-e& sovereign cloud competes for on-prem workloads.
stories.arabic: مكتب الذكاء الاصطناعي الإماراتي وأمازون ويب سيرفيسز: 72% من الشركات في الإمارات تستخدم الذكاء الاصطناعي ارتفاعاً من 53%.

stories.title: South Africa's Competition Commission Backs MTN's IHS Tower Deal, With Conditions
stories.summary: The Competition Commission recommended conditional approval of MTN's acquisition of IHS Towers to the Competition Tribunal, with fair-access, independence, lease-renewal and ownership conditions. The Tribunal decides.
bullets: The Competition Commission recommended that the Competition Tribunal approve MTN's acquisition of IHS Holding, with conditions, after meetings on September 22 and 28, 2026
IHS must give all mobile operators fair access with no preference for MTN SA, renew leases fairly and stay operationally independent
Jobs and HDP ownership are protected, and SMMEs and HDPs must take part in new tower sites
stories.lenovo: ISG: MTN consolidating Africa's largest independent tower base strengthens its edge footprint; track for ThinkEdge telco-edge plays in South Africa and Nigeria.
stories.arabic: هيئة المنافسة في جنوب أفريقيا توصي بالموافقة المشروطة على استحواذ MTN على شركة أبراج IHS.

stories.title: HPE Secures Its First AMD Helios Order in $1.2 Billion Deal With Vultr
stories.summary: HPE booked its first AMD Helios rack-scale order, $1.2bn from Vultr, with 72 MI455X GPUs per rack plus EPYC Venice CPUs and Juniper switching. At its Networking Investor Day HPE raised its Juniper synergy target to $800M.
bullets: HPE received a $1.2 billion order from Vultr to deploy AMD Helios AI Rack systems at U.S. cloud data center locations
Each rack has 72 AMD Instinct MI455X GPUs with AMD EPYC "Venice" CPUs and six HPE Juniper Networking QFX5252 scale-up switches
HPE CEO Antonio Neri said the order shows HPE can engineer the complete AI architecture, including rack-scale compute, scale-up networking and direct liquid cooling
stories.lenovo: ISG: HPE now holds the first Helios reference while AMD is HUMAIN's named JV partner (OPP-042). If HPE becomes the default Helios integrator, Lenovo's AMD path into HUMAIN narrows; Juniper lets HPE sell compute plus fabric.
stories.arabic: إتش بي إي تحصل على أول طلبية لرفوف Helios من AMD بقيمة 1.2 مليار دولار من Vultr، وترفع مستهدف وفورات استحواذ جونيبر إلى 800 مليون دولار.

stories.title: HPE to Outline Networking Priorities for Long-term Value Creation
stories.summary: HPE's Networking Investor Day release raised the Juniper synergy target to $800M run-rate by end of FY28 and set data-centre networking growth expectations; it restates the Vultr Helios order.
bullets: HPE raised its Juniper cost synergy target to $800 million in annual run-rate savings by the end of fiscal 2028, up from at least $600 million
HPE expects Data Center Networking revenue to grow at a low-to-high 50s percent CAGR through fiscal 2029, with mid-to-high 20s percent operating margins
The release also restates the $1.2 billion Vultr order, HPE's first for AMD Helios
stories.lenovo: ISG: HPE's networking scale lets it bid compute plus fabric as one bill of materials in META AI factories; Lenovo answers only through partners.
stories.arabic: إتش بي إي ترفع مستهدف وفورات استحواذ جونيبر إلى 800 مليون دولار وتتوقع نمواً قوياً لإيرادات شبكات مراكز البيانات حتى 2029.

stories.title: Lenovo AI Express with NVIDIA Accelerates Path to Hybrid AI Factory in Weeks
stories.summary: AI Express sells validated NVIDIA AI-factory configurations through partners with 15, 20 and 25 business-day order-to-ship for small, medium and large builds; fast lead times apply in non-restrictive markets.
bullets: Order-to-ship takes 15, 20 and 25 business days for the Small, Medium and Large configurations
The Large configuration is a Lenovo ThinkSystem SR680a V4 with NVIDIA HGX B300 and supports models of up to a trillion parameters
Organizations expect an average $2.79 return for every $1 invested in scaled AI execution, and 93% of enterprise respondents expect positive returns
stories.lenovo: ISG/SSG: the delivery-certainty weapon META needs. RHQ must confirm whether KSA, UAE and other META countries count as non-restrictive markets for the 15-25 day lead times.
stories.arabic: لينوفو تطلق برنامج AI Express مع إنفيديا لشحن مصانع الذكاء الاصطناعي الهجينة خلال 15 إلى 25 يوم عمل عبر الشركاء.

stories.title: China's Tencent leases 100,000 chips from Oracle to accelerate AI push, FT reports
stories.summary: Per the FT, Tencent leased about 100,000 advanced NVIDIA AI chips in Oracle's Southeast Asian data centres on a 5-year, about $7bn lease with about 30% upfront. US rules block purchases but allow overseas leasing. Unconfirmed by either company. Also Chinese rule (Tencent).
bullets: Tencent signed a five-year lease with Oracle for about 100,000 advanced AI chips across several Southeast Asian data centers
The deal is estimated at about $7 billion, with an upfront payment of about 30%
Tencent is spending more on large language models while U.S. export restrictions on advanced chips tighten
stories.lenovo: ISG: offshore GPU leasing to Chinese hyperscalers is a major, legal demand pool that Gulf neoclouds will be pitched; it also invites Washington to close the loophole. Keep META AI-factory bids clean on end-user compliance.
stories.arabic: فايننشال تايمز: تينسنت تستأجر نحو 100 ألف رقاقة ذكاء اصطناعي من أوراكل في جنوب شرق آسيا بعقد لخمس سنوات قيمته نحو 7 مليارات دولار.

stories.title: Huawei boss claims homegrown AI chip sales top Nvidia in China
stories.summary: Huawei rotating chairman Eric Xu claims Ascend has overtaken NVIDIA in China market share, without data. Huawei is deploying a 256,000-card Atlas 950 SuperCluster. Also Chinese rule (Huawei).
bullets: Huawei rotating chairman Eric Xu said Ascend has surpassed Nvidia in Chinese market share, while admitting precise data is hard to get
Nvidia H200 shipments to China accounted for less than 1 percent of Nvidia's datacenter revenue in Q2
Huawei is deploying a 256,000-card Atlas 950 SuperCluster, and its newer architecture can link up to one million NPUs
stories.lenovo: ISG: with yesterday's DeepSeek-Ascend tooling, Huawei will take a beat-NVIDIA-at-home story to META sovereign buyers before its 30 Nov overseas cluster launch. Counter-brief (OPP-048) due this quarter.
stories.arabic: رئيس هواوي الدوري يؤكد أن رقائق أسيند للذكاء الاصطناعي تجاوزت إنفيديا في حصة السوق الصينية، مع نشر عنقود Atlas 950 بسعة 256 ألف بطاقة.

stories.title: Xiaomi Auto September deliveries top 40,000 as Sky Nomad adds volume
stories.summary: Xiaomi Auto delivered more than 40,000 vehicles in September, its 2026 high, and needs about 263,525 deliveries in Q4 to hit its 550,000 target. Included by Chinese rule.
bullets: Xiaomi Auto delivered more than 40,000 vehicles in September, its highest monthly total this year
The Sky Nomad lineup launched September 7, starts at 209,900 yuan ($31,170) and got more than 10,000 locked-in orders within 4 minutes
To reach its 550,000 annual target it needs about 263,525 deliveries in Q4, roughly 2.2 times September's lower bound
stories.lenovo: Minimal: Xiaomi's scale beyond phones funds its ecosystem push in GCC retail against Motorola and Lenovo tablets.
stories.arabic: شاومي للسيارات تسلم أكثر من 40 ألف سيارة في سبتمبر، وهو أعلى مستوى لها في 2026.

stories.title: vivo X Fold6 Makes Global Debut: A New Foldable Powerhouse for Mobile Productivity
stories.summary: vivo launched the X Fold6 foldable globally after its China debut in June, with a 6,900 mAh battery and 200 MP ZEISS camera. Included by Chinese rule.
bullets: The X Fold6 has a 6900 mAh BlueVolt Battery with 80W FlashCharge, 40W Wireless FlashCharge and reverse charging
Prism Black is about 4.4mm thick unfolded and weighs 228g, while Horizon Blue is 4.8mm and 235g
It has a 200 MP ZEISS main camera with ZEISS T Coating and OIS, and up to 100x ZEISS HyperZoom
stories.lenovo: IDG: premium foldable competitor to the Motorola razr line in GCC retail.
stories.arabic: فيفو تطلق هاتفها القابل للطي X Fold6 عالمياً ببطارية 6900 ملي أمبير وكاميرا رئيسية بدقة 200 ميغابكسل.

stories.title: Honor joins Taiwan foldable phone race with Magic V6
stories.summary: Honor launched the Magic V6 in Taiwan on 30 Sep, its first foldable there, six months after entering the market. Included by Chinese rule.
bullets: Honor launched the Magic V6 in Taiwan on September 30, 2026, its first foldable phone in the market
The launch came about six months after Honor formally entered Taiwan's smartphone market in April 2026
stories.lenovo: IDG: Honor keeps expanding; active in GCC retail against the Motorola razr.
stories.arabic: هونر تدخل سوق الهواتف القابلة للطي في تايوان بهاتف Magic V6.

stories.title: Exclusive-Haier, Godrej, Blue Star failed to detect fake e-waste recycling claims, India notice shows
stories.summary: Indian tax authorities say Haier, Godrej and Blue Star wrongly claimed $714,000 in credits for recycling services never provided. Included by Chinese rule.
bullets: Indian tax authorities said the three firms wrongly claimed $714,000 in tax credits for recycling services that were never provided
Haier's share was $367,900, Godrej's $159,700 and Blue Star's $186,600, all tied to WEEE-PRO Resource Recovery Solutions
The companies admitted they had not independently verified the collection, transport, dismantling or recycling of the e-waste
stories.lenovo: Minimal: e-waste compliance is a growing GCC tender criterion; Lenovo asset-recovery services are a differentiator.
stories.arabic: إشعار ضريبي هندي: هاير وشركتان هنديتان طالبت بإعفاءات ضريبية بقيمة 714 ألف دولار عن خدمات إعادة تدوير لم تُقدم.

stories.title: ByteDance reportedly tests standalone Doubao personal assistant app
stories.summary: ByteDance is reportedly testing a standalone Doubao assistant app, tentatively Xiaodou, in internal testing only. Included by Chinese rule.
bullets: The standalone app has the tentative Chinese name Xiaodou, according to IT Home
It is still in internal testing, and its public name and features may change before launch
It was previously known internally as Spell and is being built by the team behind the Doubao phone assistant
stories.lenovo: IDG: consumer AI agents from Chinese platforms raise the bar for on-device AI on Motorola and AI PCs.
stories.arabic: بايت دانس تختبر تطبيقاً مستقلاً لمساعد دوباو الشخصي.

stories.title: MICRON TECHNOLOGY, INC. REPORTS RECORD FISCAL FOURTH-QUARTER AND FULL-YEAR 2026 RESULTS
stories.summary: Micron FQ4 revenue was $54.23bn against a $50.0bn guide, non-GAAP EPS $33.42; FQ1 guide $61.5bn with about 86.25% gross margin. More than 75% of 2027 output is committed and 2027-28 supply is expected to be much tighter; PC and phone units seen falling double digits.
bullets: Fourth-quarter fiscal 2026 revenue was $54.23 billion
GAAP diluted EPS was $32.87 and non-GAAP diluted EPS was $33.42
First-quarter guidance is revenue of $61.5 billion ± $1.5 billion, non-GAAP gross margin of approximately 86.25% and non-GAAP EPS of $38.15 ± $1.00
stories.lenovo: IDG/ISG: no memory relief before 2028. 2027 META tenders will be priced on allocation; Lenovo's leverage is volume commitment and supply-continuity messaging (OPP-045).
stories.arabic: مايكرون تسجل إيرادات قياسية بلغت 54.2 مليار دولار في الربع الرابع وتتوقع 61.5 مليار دولار للربع المقبل، محذرة من شح أكبر في إمدادات الذاكرة خلال 2027 و2028.

stories.title: Micron's AI-fueled revenue forecast blows past estimates, backlog swells
stories.summary: Reuters: Micron's FQ1 forecast of $61.5bn beat $57.02bn estimates; long-term supply commitments rose to $32bn and remaining performance obligations to about $150bn.
bullets: Micron forecast first-quarter revenue of $61.5 billion, plus or minus $1.5 billion, against analyst estimates of $57.02 billion
Customers' long-term supply commitments rose to $32 billion from the $22 billion reported in June
Remaining performance obligations reached about $150 billion, up from roughly $100 billion last quarter
stories.lenovo: IDG/ISG: customers are locking supply years ahead; OEMs without long-term commitments will face allocation, not just price, risk.
stories.arabic: توقعات مايكرون لإيرادات الربع المقبل تتجاوز التقديرات، مع ارتفاع التزامات العملاء طويلة الأجل إلى 32 مليار دولار.

stories.title: RAM supply set to worsen, says Micron, as CEO celebrates 'much higher' prices
stories.summary: Micron CEO Sanjay Mehrotra says demand will exceed supply in 2027 and 2028; new fabs funded by $25bn of H1 capex come online in 2028 and will not ease availability soon.
bullets: CEO Sanjay Mehrotra said "In calendar 2027 as well as 2028, we see demand exceeding supply"
Fourth-quarter datacenter unit gross margin was 90 percent, up from 41 percent, and annual revenue was $133.2 billion against $37.4 billion the prior year
Micron plans $25 billion of capex in the first half of the new financial year for new fabs coming online in 2028, which will not immediately ease availability
stories.lenovo: IDG/ISG: plan 2027 META pricing on continued shortage; secure allocation for named pipeline now.
stories.arabic: مايكرون: الطلب على الذاكرة سيتجاوز العرض في 2027 و2028، والمصانع الجديدة لن تخفف الشح قبل 2028.

stories.title: D램·낸드 가격 9월에도 사상 최고…상승폭은 감소
stories.published: 1 Oct 2026 01:41 KSA; first carried by eDaily 30 Sep 14:40 KSA
stories.summary: DRAMeXchange September fixed prices: PC DRAM DDR4 8Gb $26.00 (+4% MoM, record); NAND 128Gb MLC $30.61 (+0.44%). 4Q forecast DRAM +13-18%, NAND flat (estimate).
bullets: PC용 D램 범용제품(DDR4 8Gb)의 9월 평균 고정거래가격은 26달러로 8월(25달러) 대비 4% 상승
낸드플래시(128Gb MLC)의 9월 평균가는 30.61달러로 8월(30.48달러) 대비 0.44% 상승
4분기 D램은 13~18% 상승, 낸드는 보합 전망
stories.lenovo: IDG: PC DRAM still rising as Korean suppliers shift to servers; continued BOM inflation on commercial notebooks in Q4 quotes.
stories.arabic: ارتفاع متوسط سعر عقود ذاكرة DDR4 8Gb للحواسيب 4% في سبتمبر إلى 26 دولاراً، مستوى قياسي، واستمرار ارتفاع أسعار NAND للشهر الحادي والعشرين.

stories.title: S.Korea Sept exports hit record high as AI boom drives chip sales to all-time peak
stories.summary: Korea's September exports hit a record on semiconductor shipments; chip exports were $60.30bn (+262.8% YoY) per the research sweep, cross-checked with Korea JoongAng Daily (KED body not readable).
bullets: South Korea's September exports hit an all-time monthly high on strong semiconductor shipments, according to government data
Overseas sales rose 56.8% to $814.5 billion in the first nine months of 2026, topping total exports for all of 2025
stories.lenovo: IDG/ISG: hard-data confirmation that memory value is surging; supplier pricing power at a record.
stories.arabic: صادرات كوريا الجنوبية من الرقائق تبلغ مستوى قياسياً عند 60.3 مليار دولار في سبتمبر بارتفاع 262.8% على أساس سنوي.

stories.title: Huawei unveils Mate 90 phones, leans on homegrown chip design to offset US curbs
stories.summary: Huawei launched the Mate 90 series in China (5,999 to 12,999 yuan); Richard Yu said memory price rises added about $200 per handset. Included by Pillar 2 and Chinese rule.
bullets: The Mate 90 Pro Max uses the Kirin 9050 Pro chip, built with LogicFolding 3D wiring technology
Rising memory costs added about $200 to each handset's manufacturing cost
Huawei holds about 75% of China's foldable market, and the Pura X Max has sold over 1.2 million units since its April release
stories.lenovo: IDG: a quantified memory pass-through benchmark (about $200 per premium phone) for Motorola GCC pricing.
stories.arabic: هواوي تطلق سلسلة Mate 90 وتؤكد أن ارتفاع أسعار الذاكرة أضاف نحو 200 دولار لتكلفة كل هاتف في المتوسط.

stories.title: Samsung raised Galaxy S26 Ultra prices by up to $200 in Korea
stories.published: 1 Oct 2026; first reported by Korea Financial Times 05:52 KSA
stories.summary: Samsung raised Galaxy S26 prices in Korea by KRW 149,600 per tier and KRW 276,100 on the Ultra 1TB, the first post-launch rise for a Galaxy S model, amid memory price increases.
bullets: S26, S26 Plus and Ultra 256GB/512GB prices rose 149,600 won (about $110) each, and the Ultra 1TB rose 276,100 won (about $203) from 2,545,400 to 2,821,500 won
The S26 256GB rose 11.9% from 1,254,000 to 1,403,600 won, and the S26 Ultra 256GB from 1,797,400 to 1,947,000 won
Memory makers keep raising DRAM and NAND prices as they prioritise server DRAM and HBM, though Samsung has not officially given a reason
stories.lenovo: IDG: the market leader repricing mid-cycle creates cover for Motorola and Lenovo tablet price adjustments in GCC retail.
stories.arabic: سامسونج ترفع أسعار هواتف Galaxy S26 في كوريا بمقدار 149,600 وون بسبب تكاليف الذاكرة.

stories.title: Mizuho raises Micron stock price target to $1,400 on AI strength
stories.summary: Mizuho raised its Micron target to $1,400 (Outperform) and sees 2027 HBM pricing up 70-100% YoY (estimate). KB Securities sees more than +100%.
bullets: Mizuho raised its Micron price target to $1,400 from $1,300 and kept an Outperform rating
Micron's fourth-quarter revenue of $54.2 billion and EPS of $33.42 compared with consensus of $51.5 billion and $31.84
November-quarter guidance of $61.5 billion revenue and $38.15 EPS compares with consensus of $56.7 billion and $36.03
stories.lenovo: ISG: every house now models HBM up 70-120% in 2027; GPU server pricing in 2027 META AI-factory bids must assume a step up.
stories.arabic: ميزوهو ترفع السعر المستهدف لسهم مايكرون إلى 1400 دولار وتتوقع ارتفاع أسعار ذاكرة HBM بين 70 و100% في 2027.
